item.title: Bishop Ford Freeway rehab project begins Tuesday, IDOT says major delays expected and drivers should seek other routes
item.description: The Illinois Department of Transportation has announced that the rehabilitation of the Bishop Ford (I-94) through Chicago, Dolton, Burnham, Riverdale, Calumet City and South Holland is scheduled to begin Tuesday, March 24.

item.title: Frank Thomas files lawsuit against White Sox, alleging use of name and likeness without his permission
item.description: In a lawsuit filed Monday in Cook County Circuit Court naming the Chicago White Sox and sports apparel companies Nike and Fanatics, Inc., as defendants, Frank Thomas — widely considered the best player in franchise history — claims the defendants profited from selling items using his identity without his permission.

item.title: Wednesday forecast: Parts of Chicagoland likely to see high temps at or above 70 degrees as warm air moves in
item.description: High temperatures will soar close to 70 degrees in some locations Wednesday in Chicagoland, as high pressure just off the East Coast will allow a more south to southwesterly flow, bringing warm temps for late March to our area.

item.title: Johnson says he prioritizes public safety in aftermath of Loyola freshman's murder
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson expressed his commitment to public safety and announced enhanced security measures for the CTA, as well as the promotion of 48 new detectives, in response to the recent murder of a Loyola University freshman and the firing of his Deputy Mayor for Community Safety.
